title: Outlook search misses recent emails
symptom: Outlook search does not find emails from the last few weeks
user_description: I know the email from the courier came last week, I saw it! But when I search in Outlook it only finds old stuff. It's driving me mad.

options.why: The mail is all there. Only the search index is out of date.

options.text: Delete old emails so search has less to look through
options.why: Deleting mail risks losing records and does not fix a broken index.

options.text: Rebuild the Windows search index (Indexing Options, Advanced, Rebuild), let it finish, then test the search again
options.why: Outlook search on a PC relies on the Windows search index. Rebuilding it makes recent mail findable again.
Reinstalling takes far longer and does not usually fix a stale index.

hints: Is the email missing, or just not found by search?
What does Outlook use to search quickly?
How long might a rebuild take?
real_world_tip: Rebuilding can take hours on a big mailbox, and search results are incomplete until it finishes. Start it at the end of the day if you can.
